response.sql: WITH filtered_behavior AS (SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg WHERE ab.peercorr > 0.149 AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL), group_counts AS (SELECT translink, ordertypedist, COUNT(*) as count FROM filtered_behavior GROUP BY translink, ordertypedist), type_totals AS (SELECT ordertypedist, SUM(count) as type_total FROM group_counts GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT g.translink, g.ordertypedist, g.count, CAST(g.count AS REAL) / t.type_total as fraction FROM group_counts g JOIN type_totals t ON g.ordertypedist = t.ordertypedist ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10;
